blocks.source: Canto II
blocks.translation: Canto II

blocks.source: Lo giorno se n’andava, e l’aere bruno
blocks.translation: Day was departing, and the embrowned air

blocks.source: toglieva li animai che sono in terra
blocks.translation: Released the animals that are on earth

blocks.source: da le fatiche loro; e io sol uno
blocks.translation: From their fatigues; and I the only one

blocks.source: m’apparecchiava a sostener la guerra
blocks.translation: Made myself ready to sustain the war,

blocks.source: sì del cammino e sì de la pietate,
blocks.translation: Both of the way and likewise of the woe,

blocks.source: che ritrarrà la mente che non erra.
blocks.translation: Which memory that errs not shall retrace.

blocks.source: O muse, o alto ingegno, or m’aiutate;
blocks.translation: O Muses, O high genius, now assist me!

blocks.source: o mente che scrivesti ciò ch’io vidi,
blocks.translation: O memory, that didst write down what I saw,

blocks.source: qui si parrà la tua nobilitate.
blocks.translation: Here thy nobility shall be manifest!

blocks.source: Io cominciai: «Poeta che mi guidi,
blocks.translation: And I began: “Poet, who guidest me,

blocks.source: guarda la mia virtù s’ell’ è possente,
blocks.translation: Regard my manhood, if it be sufficient,

blocks.source: prima ch’a l’alto passo tu mi fidi.
blocks.translation: Ere to the arduous pass thou dost confide me.

blocks.source: Tu dici che di Silvïo il parente,
blocks.translation: Thou sayest, that of Silvius the parent,

blocks.source: corruttibile ancora, ad immortale
blocks.translation: While yet corruptible, unto the world

blocks.source: secolo andò, e fu sensibilmente.
blocks.translation: Immortal went, and was there bodily.

blocks.source: Però, se l’avversario d’ogne male
blocks.translation: But if the adversary of all evil

blocks.source: cortese i fu, pensando l’alto effetto
blocks.translation: Was courteous, thinking of the high effect

blocks.source: ch’uscir dovea di lui, e ’l chi e ’l quale
blocks.translation: That issue would from him, and who, and what,

blocks.source: non pare indegno ad omo d’intelletto;
blocks.translation: To men of intellect unmeet it seems not;

blocks.source: ch’e’ fu de l’alma Roma e di suo impero
blocks.translation: For he was of great Rome, and of her empire

blocks.source: ne l’empireo ciel per padre eletto:
blocks.translation: In the empyreal heaven as father chosen;

blocks.source: la quale e ’l quale, a voler dir lo vero,
blocks.translation: The which and what, wishing to speak the truth,

blocks.source: fu stabilita per lo loco santo
blocks.translation: Were stablished as the holy place, wherein

blocks.source: u’ siede il successor del maggior Piero.
blocks.translation: Sits the successor of the greatest Peter.

blocks.source: Per quest’ andata onde li dai tu vanto,
blocks.translation: Upon this journey, whence thou givest him vaunt,

blocks.source: intese cose che furon cagione
blocks.translation: Things did he hear, which the occasion were

blocks.source: di sua vittoria e del papale ammanto.
blocks.translation: Both of his victory and the papal mantle.

blocks.source: Andovvi poi lo Vas d’elezïone,
blocks.translation: Thither went afterwards the Chosen Vessel,

blocks.source: per recarne conforto a quella fede
blocks.translation: To bring back comfort thence unto that Faith,

blocks.source: ch’è principio a la via di salvazione.
blocks.translation: Which of salvation’s way is the beginning.

blocks.source: Ma io, perché venirvi? o chi ’l concede?
blocks.translation: But I, why thither come, or who concedes it?

blocks.source: Io non Enëa, io non Paulo sono;
blocks.translation: I not Aeneas am, I am not Paul,

blocks.source: me degno a ciò né io né altri ’l crede.
blocks.translation: Nor I, nor others, think me worthy of it.

blocks.source: Per che, se del venire io m’abbandono,
blocks.translation: Therefore, if I resign myself to come,

blocks.source: temo che la venuta non sia folle.
blocks.translation: I fear the coming may be ill-advised;

blocks.source: Se’ savio; intendi me’ ch’i’ non ragiono».
blocks.translation: Thou’rt wise, and knowest better than I speak.”

blocks.source: E qual è quei che disvuol ciò che volle
blocks.translation: And as he is, who unwills what he willed,

blocks.source: e per novi pensier cangia proposta,
blocks.translation: And by new thoughts doth his intention change,

blocks.source: sì che dal cominciar tutto si tolle,
blocks.translation: So that from his design he quite withdraws,

blocks.source: tal mi fec’ ïo ’n quella oscura costa,
blocks.translation: Such I became, upon that dark hillside,

blocks.source: perché, pensando, consumai la ’mpresa
blocks.translation: Because, in thinking, I consumed the emprise,

blocks.source: che fu nel cominciar cotanto tosta.
blocks.translation: Which was so very prompt in the beginning.

blocks.source: «S’i’ ho ben la parola tua intesa»,
blocks.translation: “If I have well thy language understood,”

blocks.source: rispuose del magnanimo quell’ ombra,
blocks.translation: Replied that shade of the Magnanimous,

blocks.source: «l’anima tua è da viltade offesa;
blocks.translation: “Thy soul attainted is with cowardice,

blocks.source: la qual molte fïate l’omo ingombra
blocks.translation: Which many times a man encumbers so,

blocks.source: sì che d’onrata impresa lo rivolve,
blocks.translation: It turns him back from honoured enterprise,

blocks.source: come falso veder bestia quand’ ombra.
blocks.translation: As false sight doth a beast, when he is shy.

blocks.source: Da questa tema acciò che tu ti solve,
blocks.translation: That thou mayst free thee from this apprehension,

blocks.source: dirotti perch’ io venni e quel ch’io ’ntesi
blocks.translation: I’ll tell thee why I came, and what I heard

blocks.source: nel primo punto che di te mi dolve.
blocks.translation: At the first moment when I grieved for thee.

blocks.source: Io era tra color che son sospesi,
blocks.translation: Among those was I who are in suspense,

blocks.source: e donna mi chiamò beata e bella,
blocks.translation: And a fair, saintly Lady called to me

blocks.source: tal che di comandare io la richiesi.
blocks.translation: In such wise, I besought her to command me.

blocks.source: Lucevan li occhi suoi più che la stella;
blocks.translation: Her eyes were shining brighter than the star;

blocks.source: e cominciommi a dir soave e piana,
blocks.translation: And she began to say, gentle and low,

blocks.source: con angelica voce, in sua favella:
blocks.translation: With voice angelical, in her own language:

blocks.source: “O anima cortese mantoana,
blocks.translation: ‘O spirit courteous of Mantua,

blocks.source: di cui la fama ancor nel mondo dura,
blocks.translation: Of whom the fame still in the world endures,

blocks.source: e durerà quanto ’l mondo lontana,
blocks.translation: And shall endure, long-lasting as the world;

blocks.source: l’amico mio, e non de la ventura,
blocks.translation: A friend of mine, and not the friend of fortune,

blocks.source: ne la diserta piaggia è impedito
blocks.translation: Upon the desert slope is so impeded

blocks.source: sì nel cammin, che vòlt’ è per paura;
blocks.translation: Upon his way, that he has turned through terror,

blocks.source: e temo che non sia già sì smarrito,
blocks.translation: And may, I fear, already be so lost,

blocks.source: ch’io mi sia tardi al soccorso levata,
blocks.translation: That I too late have risen to his succour,

blocks.source: per quel ch’i’ ho di lui nel cielo udito.
blocks.translation: From that which I have heard of him in Heaven.

blocks.source: Or movi, e con la tua parola ornata
blocks.translation: Bestir thee now, and with thy speech ornate,

blocks.source: e con ciò c’ha mestieri al suo campare,
blocks.translation: And with what needful is for his release,

blocks.source: l’aiuta sì ch’i’ ne sia consolata.
blocks.translation: Assist him so, that I may be consoled.

blocks.source: I’ son Beatrice che ti faccio andare;
blocks.translation: Beatrice am I, who do bid thee go;

blocks.source: vegno del loco ove tornar disio;
blocks.translation: I come from there, where I would fain return;

blocks.source: amor mi mosse, che mi fa parlare.
blocks.translation: Love moved me, which compelleth me to speak.

blocks.source: Quando sarò dinanzi al segnor mio,
blocks.translation: When I shall be in presence of my Lord,

blocks.source: di te mi loderò sovente a lui”.
blocks.translation: Full often will I praise thee unto him.’

blocks.source: Tacette allora, e poi comincia’ io:
blocks.translation: Then paused she, and thereafter I began:

blocks.source: “O donna di virtù sola per cui
blocks.translation: ‘O Lady of virtue, thou alone through whom

blocks.source: l’umana spezie eccede ogne contento
blocks.translation: The human race exceedeth all contained

blocks.source: di quel ciel c’ha minor li cerchi sui,
blocks.translation: Within the heaven that has the lesser circles,

blocks.source: tanto m’aggrada il tuo comandamento,
blocks.translation: So grateful unto me is thy commandment,

blocks.source: che l’ubidir, se già fosse, m’è tardi;
blocks.translation: To obey, if ’twere already done, were late;

blocks.source: più non t’è uo’ ch’aprirmi il tuo talento.
blocks.translation: No farther need’st thou ope to me thy wish.

blocks.source: Ma dimmi la cagion che non ti guardi
blocks.translation: But the cause tell me why thou dost not shun

blocks.source: de lo scender qua giuso in questo centro
blocks.translation: The here descending down into this centre,

blocks.source: de l’ampio loco ove tornar tu ardi”.
blocks.translation: From the vast place thou burnest to return to.’

blocks.source: “Da che tu vuo’ saver cotanto a dentro,
blocks.translation: ‘Since thou wouldst fain so inwardly discern,

blocks.source: dirotti brievemente”, mi rispuose,
blocks.translation: Briefly will I relate,’ she answered me,

blocks.source: “perch’ i’ non temo di venir qua entro.
blocks.translation: ‘Why I am not afraid to enter here.

blocks.source: Temer si dee di sole quelle cose
blocks.translation: Of those things only should one be afraid

blocks.source: c’hanno potenza di fare altrui male;
blocks.translation: Which have the power of doing others harm;

blocks.source: de l’altre no, ché non son paurose.
blocks.translation: Of the rest, no; because they are not fearful.

blocks.source: I’ son fatta da Dio, sua mercé, tale,
blocks.translation: God in his mercy such created me

blocks.source: che la vostra miseria non mi tange,
blocks.translation: That misery of yours attains me not,

blocks.source: né fiamma d’esto ’ncendio non m’assale.
blocks.translation: Nor any flame assails me of this burning.

blocks.source: Donna è gentil nel ciel che si compiange
blocks.translation: A gentle Lady is in Heaven, who grieves

blocks.source: di questo ’mpedimento ov’ io ti mando,
blocks.translation: At this impediment, to which I send thee,

blocks.source: sì che duro giudicio là sù frange.
blocks.translation: So that stern judgment there above is broken.

blocks.source: Questa chiese Lucia in suo dimando
blocks.translation: In her entreaty she besought Lucia,

blocks.source: e disse:—Or ha bisogno il tuo fedele
blocks.translation: And said, “Thy faithful one now stands in need

blocks.source: di te, e io a te lo raccomando—.
blocks.translation: Of thee, and unto thee I recommend him.”

blocks.source: Lucia, nimica di ciascun crudele,
blocks.translation: Lucia, foe of all that cruel is,

blocks.source: si mosse, e venne al loco dov’ i’ era,
blocks.translation: Hastened away, and came unto the place

blocks.source: che mi sedea con l’antica Rachele.
blocks.translation: Where I was sitting with the ancient Rachel.

blocks.source: Disse:—Beatrice, loda di Dio vera,
blocks.translation: “Beatrice” said she, “the true praise of God,

blocks.source: ché non soccorri quei che t’amò tanto,
blocks.translation: Why succourest thou not him, who loved thee so,

blocks.source: ch’uscì per te de la volgare schiera?
blocks.translation: Who for thy sake rose above the common crowd?

blocks.source: Non odi tu la pieta del suo pianto,
blocks.translation: Dost thou not hear the pity of his plaint?

blocks.source: non vedi tu la morte che ’l combatte
blocks.translation: Dost thou not see the death that combats him

blocks.source: su la fiumana ove ’l mar non ha vanto?—.
blocks.translation: Upon that flood, beside which the sea has no boast?

blocks.source: Al mondo non fur mai persone ratte
blocks.translation: Never were persons in the world so swift

blocks.source: a far lor pro o a fuggir lor danno,
blocks.translation: To work their weal and to escape their woe,

blocks.source: com’ io, dopo cotai parole fatte,
blocks.translation: As I, after such words as these were uttered,

blocks.source: venni qua giù del mio beato scanno,
blocks.translation: Came hither downward from my blessed seat,

blocks.source: fidandomi del tuo parlare onesto,
blocks.translation: Confiding in thy dignified discourse,

blocks.source: ch’onora te e quei ch’udito l’hanno”.
blocks.translation: Which honours thee, and those who’ve listened to it.’

blocks.source: Poscia che m’ebbe ragionato questo,
blocks.translation: After she thus had spoken unto me,

blocks.source: li occhi lucenti lagrimando volse,
blocks.translation: Weeping, her shining eyes she turned away;

blocks.source: per che mi fece del venir più presto.
blocks.translation: Whereby she made me swifter in my coming;

blocks.source: E venni a te così com’ ella volse:
blocks.translation: And unto thee I came, as she desired;

blocks.source: d’inanzi a quella fiera ti levai
blocks.translation: I have delivered thee from that wild beast,

blocks.source: che del bel monte il corto andar ti tolse.
blocks.translation: Which barred the beautiful mountain’s short ascent.

blocks.source: Dunque: che è? perché, perché restai,
blocks.translation: What is it, then?  Why, why dost thou delay?

blocks.source: perché tanta viltà nel core allette,
blocks.translation: Why is such baseness bedded in thy heart?

blocks.source: perché ardire e franchezza non hai,
blocks.translation: Daring and hardihood why hast thou not,

blocks.source: poscia che tai tre donne benedette
blocks.translation: Seeing that three such Ladies benedight

blocks.source: curan di te ne la corte del cielo,
blocks.translation: Are caring for thee in the court of Heaven,

blocks.source: e ’l mio parlar tanto ben ti promette?».
blocks.translation: And so much good my speech doth promise thee?”

blocks.source: Quali fioretti dal notturno gelo
blocks.translation: Even as the flowerets, by nocturnal chill,

blocks.source: chinati e chiusi, poi che ’l sol li ’mbianca,
blocks.translation: Bowed down and closed, when the sun whitens them,

blocks.source: si drizzan tutti aperti in loro stelo,
blocks.translation: Uplift themselves all open on their stems;

blocks.source: tal mi fec’ io di mia virtude stanca,
blocks.translation: Such I became with my exhausted strength,

blocks.source: e tanto buono ardire al cor mi corse,
blocks.translation: And such good courage to my heart there coursed,

blocks.source: ch’i’ cominciai come persona franca:
blocks.translation: That I began, like an intrepid person:

blocks.source: «Oh pietosa colei che mi soccorse!
blocks.translation: “O she compassionate, who succoured me,

blocks.source: e te cortese ch’ubidisti tosto
blocks.translation: And courteous thou, who hast obeyed so soon

blocks.source: a le vere parole che ti porse!
blocks.translation: The words of truth which she addressed to thee!

blocks.source: Tu m’hai con disiderio il cor disposto
blocks.translation: Thou hast my heart so with desire disposed

blocks.source: sì al venir con le parole tue,
blocks.translation: To the adventure, with these words of thine,

blocks.source: ch’i’ son tornato nel primo proposto.
blocks.translation: That to my first intent I have returned.

blocks.source: Or va, ch’un sol volere è d’ambedue:
blocks.translation: Now go, for one sole will is in us both,

blocks.source: tu duca, tu segnore e tu maestro».
blocks.translation: Thou Leader, and thou Lord, and Master thou.”

blocks.source: Così li dissi; e poi che mosso fue,
blocks.translation: Thus said I to him; and when he had moved,

blocks.source: intrai per lo cammino alto e silvestro.
blocks.translation: I entered on the deep and savage way.
